candidates.reason: Faithful centred stack with clear hierarchy (headline > CTA > body > footer) and good wrapping ('Staff picks / for spring'), but the whole column is a bit small for the square canvas: wide empty side margins, and the book cover could be larger. Only minor polish needed.

Same stack as the original, but there is a large dead gap between the book cover and the headline while the text block below is tightly packed. 'Staff picks for / spring' leaves 'spring' alone on the second line, and the cover and text are undersized, so the layout looks like a shrunk copy.

Larger, readable headline and CTA with good hierarchy, but the 'Inkwell & Lantern Books.' footer is jammed right under the button. The bottom margin is noticeably tighter than the top margin, which makes the lower half feel crowded and unbalanced.

The book cover is blown up to fill about 70% of the canvas and overpowers the message. The headline is shrunk to a small left-aligned line, and the body copy, CTA and tiny footer are crammed into one cramped row against the bottom edge. The CTA is buried and the footer is barely readable, so the hierarchy is inverted.
